name: com.zeamprism/pass-client
title: @zeampass/client
description: The buyer side of ZEAM :: Pass: a wallet in front of a paid MCP server or URL. Pays by x402 or MPP.

environmentVariables.name: PASS_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The key of the wallet that pays. It signs locally and is never sent. Without it the client lists tools and calls the free ones.

environmentVariables.name: PASS_MCP_URL
environmentVariables.description: The paid MCP endpoint to stand in front of: any x402 MCP endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: PASS_MAX_SPEND
environmentVariables.description: Ceiling on what one run pays, in millionths of a dollar. 0 removes it.
